name: EvilDrac
bio: EvilDrac is an Admin of Silver Springs Survival and the founder of the Wiki, and is otherwise known as Drac or Ber. He is very fond of magic and has expressed interest in alchemy. In the real world, however, Drac holds an interest in digital designing and creative works.
history:
EvilDrac became a Moderator on March 2nd, 2015 (along with MrJoned) and was an Admin starting July 15th of the same year up until January 1st, 2018, when he stepped down to the Mod position for personal reasons.

On April 21st 2020, EvilDrac re-a s c e n d e d.
